# Fire extinguisher mounting locations

> **[Unverified]** This page rests on a single community report. Cross-check before relying on it.

> Items marked **[Partial]** are only partly confirmed by the source and need more work. They stay in the review queue and are firmed up, corrected or removed as more sources come in.

## Summary

Mount the fire extinguisher easily reachable by either driver or passenger. [t234]

## Procedure

> **[Partial]** Needs more work: the verifier could confirm only part of this procedure (the steps marked [Partial], or whether the list is complete). Steps or precautions may be wrong or missing; read the source thread before relying on it. Later runs fill it in as more sources are found.

1. Mount the fire extinguisher in a location easily reachable by either driver or passenger.
2. Secure the unit to prevent it from becoming loose during sudden stops or accidents.

_Procedure reported by [t234]._

## Parts

- [Partial] Fire Extinguisher Mount: Often comes with a specific angled top mount [t234]

## Tips & gotchas

- Consider the cargo area on the driver side back wall for easy access. [t234]
- Door cup holders offer an alternative but require securing to prevent movement. [t234]

## Common mistakes

- Mounting too high or loosely, causing it to fly forward and hit occupants (e.g., foot triggering the pull tab). [t234]
